recentItems.title: SABCNews AM Headlines @15H00 | 06 October 2026
recentItems.description:
*Former Crime Intelligence official, Feroz Khan's scheduled virtual appearance at the Madlanga Commission has been postponed indefinitely.
He was unable to proceed with his evidence following a deadly shooting on the R21 in Ekurhuleni last night.

*Police are investigating murder and attempted murder after last night's a shooting on the R21, heading to OR Tambo International Airport.
One person died, and two were wounded. 

*Transport operators, passengers and small businesses are worried about the impact of the latest fuel price increases, warning that higher fuel costs will place more pressure on households and operating budgets.

*Kenya has confirmed its first Ebola case in a citizen who arrived in Nairobi from the Democratic Republic of Congo on Saturday.

recentItems.title: Mpumalanga Education announces readiness of 2026 matric final exams
recentItems.description:
The Mpumalanga education  has announced its state of readiness to administer the 2026 matric final exam. The Department held a media briefing at Lowveld High  School in Mbombela.The province will have 588 exama centers across the province. 

Education MEC Lindi Masina says the province has over 85 thousand, which includes full-time, part-time, and progressed learners. Their largest cohorts ever. recentItems.title: BRICS+ Fashion Summit in Moscow
recentItems.description:
Moscow hosted the BRICS+ Fashion Summit, bringing together designers, manufacturers, retailers and investors from BRICS countries and other emerging markets. 

The summit's programme focused on global transformation, investment, manufacturing technologies, consumer behaviour and brand expansion.

BRICS is reshaping global trade, and fashion is becoming part of that shift.
